esg-readiness.logic: Each dimension is rated from 1 to 5. The overall screening result is the arithmetic mean of entered ratings. The lowest-rated dimensions are surfaced as priorities.
esg-readiness.units: Scores are ordinal self-assessment ratings, not certification scores.
esg-readiness.limitations: Results depend on user judgement and evidence quality. The screen does not establish compliance with any reporting standard.
esg-readiness.evidence: Verify policies, governance records, metrics, audit evidence, stakeholder records and current reporting requirements.

mining-carbon-calculator.logic: Diesel emissions (tCO₂e) = diesel litres × entered diesel factor (kgCO₂e/L) ÷ 1,000. Grid emissions (tCO₂e) = grid kWh × entered grid factor (kgCO₂e/kWh) ÷ 1,000. Total = diesel + grid. Intensity = total ÷ entered production units. Renewable share = renewable kWh ÷ (renewable kWh + grid kWh) × 100.
mining-carbon-calculator.units: Fuel activity uses litres per year. Electricity uses kWh per year. Emissions are shown in tonnes CO₂e.
mining-carbon-calculator.limitations: The screen omits sources not entered, lifecycle emissions, uncertainty ranges and formal inventory boundary decisions.
mining-carbon-calculator.evidence: Verify fuel records, metered electricity, production data, reporting boundary and current emission factors.

renewable-transition-calculator.logic: Potential diesel displacement = the lower of annual diesel use and solar generation × entered generator fuel rate. Fuel saving = displaced litres × fuel price. Avoided emissions = displaced litres × entered diesel factor ÷ 1,000. Simple payback = entered project CAPEX ÷ annual fuel saving when both are positive.
renewable-transition-calculator.units: Diesel is litres per year, solar is kWh per year, fuel rate is litres per kWh, and avoided emissions are tonnes CO₂e.
renewable-transition-calculator.limitations: The screen does not model hourly dispatch, degradation, financing, O&M, curtailment, reserve margin or generator efficiency changes at partial load.
renewable-transition-calculator.evidence: Verify solar resource, hourly load profile, generator performance, delivered fuel cost, project cost and current emission factors.

stakeholder-mapper.logic: The tool records influence, interest and relationship strength on a 1 to 5 scale, then uses those visible ratings to structure engagement priority.
stakeholder-mapper.units: All ratings are ordinal planning inputs from 1 to 5.
stakeholder-mapper.limitations: Stakeholder relationships are dynamic and context-specific. A matrix does not replace direct engagement or rights-holder analysis.
stakeholder-mapper.evidence: Verify stakeholder identity, mandate, interests, influence, rights, current relationship and engagement history.

government-relations-risk.logic: Each institutional and execution risk is rated from 1 to 5. The arithmetic mean provides an overall exposure screen. Highest-rated dimensions are surfaced first.
government-relations-risk.units: Scores are ordinal exposure ratings from 1 to 5.
government-relations-risk.limitations: The tool does not provide legal advice, political forecasting or an assessment of any public official.
government-relations-risk.evidence: Verify current law, permit status, agency mandates, formal correspondence, policy documents and internal decision rights.

social-licence-health.logic: The tool averages entered 1 to 5 ratings across trust, grievance response, local participation, commitments, communications and related dimensions. Lowest-rated areas are surfaced for follow-up.
social-licence-health.units: Scores are ordinal self-assessment ratings from 1 to 5.
social-licence-health.limitations: The screen is not a community survey and does not substitute for direct engagement, rights-based analysis or independent social research.
social-licence-health.evidence: Verify grievance data, commitments, engagement records, local employment and procurement evidence, environmental concerns and community feedback.

executive-brief-generator.logic: The tool structures user-entered information into decision required, context, facts, unknowns, stakeholders, risks, options and next action.
executive-brief-generator.limitations: The output reflects only information supplied by the user. It does not verify facts or choose a decision.
executive-brief-generator.evidence: Verify factual claims, decision authority, deadlines, stakeholders, risks and supporting documents before circulation.

board-question-generator.logic: The tool combines a user-selected decision area with a fixed set of governance, evidence, downside, stakeholder and follow-up questions.
board-question-generator.limitations: Questions are prompts for oversight and do not replace board papers, fiduciary duties, legal advice or specialist review.
board-question-generator.evidence: Verify the proposal, assumptions, downside case, decision rights, risk ownership and monitoring plan.

career-evidence-builder.logic: The tool combines situation, action, evidence, verified outcome and lesson into an evidence-led achievement statement and interview structure.
career-evidence-builder.limitations: The tool does not verify employment history or outcomes. Users should avoid unsupported claims.
career-evidence-builder.evidence: Verify dates, role scope, metrics, documents, project records and attributable outcomes.

job-fit-analyzer.logic: The browser compares predefined professional themes appearing in both the job description and profile text, then surfaces matched and missing themes. It intentionally avoids a percentage fit score.
job-fit-analyzer.limitations: Keyword overlap does not measure leadership quality, selection probability or overall suitability.
job-fit-analyzer.evidence: Verify role requirements, transferable experience, work authorization, language requirements and evidence for each claimed capability.

speaking-question-generator.logic: The tool combines topic, audience, format and context with a fixed set of evidence, trade-off, stakeholder and action-oriented question patterns.
speaking-question-generator.limitations: Questions are preparation prompts. They do not establish factual claims about the topic.
speaking-question-generator.evidence: Verify event context, audience needs, current evidence, sensitive issues and any statistics used in responses.

white-paper-navigator.logic: The tool searches a local index of public research titles and topic keywords in the browser and returns matching documents.
white-paper-navigator.limitations: The search index covers the published library on this site and is not a general web search.
white-paper-navigator.evidence: Review the source list, date and limitations inside each selected paper.

guyana-investment-dashboard.logic: The dashboard presents structured diligence questions and official starting points by sector rather than a single investment score.
guyana-investment-dashboard.limitations: Policies, incentives, fees and institutional procedures change. The dashboard is not investment advice.
guyana-investment-dashboard.evidence: Verify current requirements with official agencies, qualified advisers, contracts, project data and current legislation.

guyana-regulatory-navigator.logic: The navigator matches user search terms to a curated list of public institutions and their broad administrative roles.
guyana-regulatory-navigator.limitations: Institutional mandates and procedures change. A listing does not confirm which approvals apply to a specific project.
guyana-regulatory-navigator.evidence: Verify current agency mandates, forms, fees, legislation, permit conditions and official contact channels.

responsible-mining-assessment.logic: Each responsible-mining practice is rated from 1 to 5. The arithmetic mean provides an overall screen and the lowest-rated dimensions are surfaced as priorities.
responsible-mining-assessment.units: Scores are ordinal self-assessment ratings from 1 to 5.
responsible-mining-assessment.limitations: The screen is not an audit, certification or assurance engagement.
responsible-mining-assessment.evidence: Verify environmental, safety, workforce, community, human-rights, procurement, closure, governance and compliance records.

executive-templates.logic: The library provides structured fields for recurring executive tasks such as issue escalation, stakeholder engagement, meeting preparation and action tracking.
executive-templates.limitations: Templates require adaptation to the organisation, decision, jurisdiction and delegated authority.
executive-templates.evidence: Verify owners, dates, decision rights, source documents, commitments and closure evidence.

water-demand-calculator.logic: End-use demand (m³/day) = people × litres per person per day ÷ 1,000 + process use. Required supply = end-use demand ÷ (1 − loss rate). Stress supply = required supply × (1 + surge rate). Storage = required supply × buffer days.
water-demand-calculator.units: Population is people, consumption is litres/person/day, process use is m³/day, losses and surge are percentages, and storage is m³.
water-demand-calculator.limitations: The screen excludes source reliability, treatment, rainfall, fire reserve, drought duration, water quality and detailed hydraulic design.
water-demand-calculator.evidence: Verify demand records, seasonal variation, source yield, regulatory criteria, treatment requirements and emergency storage standards.

local-content-calculator.logic: Local procurement share = qualifying local procurement ÷ total procurement × 100. Local workforce share = qualifying local workers ÷ total workforce × 100. Target local spend = total procurement × target share. Shortfall = max(0, target local spend − current qualifying local spend).
local-content-calculator.units: Procurement values use the user-entered currency. Workforce values are counts. Shares are percentages.
local-content-calculator.limitations: The tool does not define who or what qualifies as local and does not apply indirect economic multipliers.
local-content-calculator.evidence: Verify the applicable legal or policy definition, supplier classification, spend recognition, workforce eligibility and reporting period.

diesel-cost-carbon.logic: Annual fuel cost = litres × delivered price per litre. Annual diesel emissions = litres × entered emission factor ÷ 1,000. Reduction litres = litres × reduction rate. Reduction cost = reduction litres × price. Reduction emissions = reduction litres × factor ÷ 1,000.
diesel-cost-carbon.units: Fuel is litres/year, cost uses the entered currency, emission factor is kgCO₂e/L and emissions are tonnes CO₂e.
diesel-cost-carbon.limitations: The screen excludes fuel-price escalation, non-diesel sources, lifecycle emissions and detailed equipment duty cycles.
diesel-cost-carbon.evidence: Verify fuel reconciliations, delivered price, operating days, production definition, reporting boundary and current emission factor.

solar-battery-sizing.logic: Indicative solar DC capacity = daily energy demand ÷ [peak-sun hours × (1 − loss rate)]. Average load = daily demand ÷ 24. Usable battery energy = average load × autonomy hours. Nominal battery energy = usable energy ÷ (usable depth of discharge × round-trip efficiency).
solar-battery-sizing.units: Demand is kWh/day, solar capacity is kWp, load is kW and battery energy is kWh.
solar-battery-sizing.limitations: The screen does not model hourly load shape, inverter clipping, temperature, degradation, curtailment, reserve margin, generator interaction or grid constraints.
solar-battery-sizing.evidence: Verify measured load data, solar resource, equipment performance, operating philosophy, autonomy requirement and engineering design criteria.

community-investment-prioritizer.logic: Priority score = community evidence × 25% + expected impact × 25% + urgency × 20% + reach × 15% + feasibility × 15%. Initiatives are sorted from highest to lowest score.
community-investment-prioritizer.units: Each component is an ordinal rating from 1 to 5. The weighted score is reported on the same 1 to 5 scale.
community-investment-prioritizer.limitations: Weights are planning choices rather than a universal standard. Ranking does not replace participation, rights-holder engagement or programme appraisal.
community-investment-prioritizer.evidence: Verify community-defined needs, affected groups, expected outcomes, cost, delivery capacity, rights impacts and monitoring evidence.

esg-materiality-matrix.logic: Screening score = (stakeholder importance + business impact) ÷ 2. Evidence confidence is reported separately to show where higher scores rely on weaker evidence.
esg-materiality-matrix.units: Inputs and screening scores use an ordinal 1 to 5 scale.
esg-materiality-matrix.limitations: The screen does not establish formal impact materiality, financial materiality or double materiality under any reporting regime.
esg-materiality-matrix.evidence: Verify stakeholder evidence, impact assessments, financial analysis, reporting requirements and source confidence.

grievance-trend-analyzer.logic: The tool counts records, identifies open or unresolved records, calculates average entered days, counts severity 4 to 5 records and ranks grievance categories by frequency.
grievance-trend-analyzer.units: Severity is the user-entered scale. Days are calendar days as entered. Category results are counts.
grievance-trend-analyzer.limitations: Frequency does not measure root cause, rights impact or seriousness by itself. Personal data should not be entered.
grievance-trend-analyzer.evidence: Verify case status, category coding, severity definition, closure evidence, confidentiality controls and safeguarding requirements.

executive-100-day-plan.logic: The tool structures a mandate, priorities, stakeholders, risks and available evidence into three phases: days 1 to 30, 31 to 60 and 61 to 100, followed by a day-100 review.
executive-100-day-plan.limitations: The plan is a management template and does not verify organisational context, authority, resources or feasibility.
executive-100-day-plan.evidence: Verify mandate, decision rights, baseline metrics, stakeholder expectations, constraints, owners and review cadence.

government-meeting-brief.logic: The tool structures agency context, meeting objective, verified facts, decision sought, sensitivities, commitment boundaries and follow-up into a disciplined meeting brief.
government-meeting-brief.limitations: The output does not verify legal authority, policy position or the accuracy of user-entered facts.
government-meeting-brief.evidence: Verify agency mandate, official correspondence, current law, approved organisational position, delegated authority and commitments.

responsible-procurement-assessment.logic: Each procurement-control dimension is rated from 1 to 5. The arithmetic mean provides an overall self-assessment and the lowest-rated dimensions are surfaced as priority gaps.
responsible-procurement-assessment.units: Scores are ordinal self-assessment ratings from 1 to 5.
responsible-procurement-assessment.limitations: The screen is not a supplier audit, sanctions opinion, legal review or compliance certification.
responsible-procurement-assessment.evidence: Verify supplier due diligence, conflicts controls, tender records, contract clauses, environmental and human-rights expectations, approval trails and audit evidence.
